Regular, please.
How much is gas?
Can I pay at the pump?

dialogue.en: Fill it up, please.
Regular or premium?
Regular, please. How much is gas?
Three dollars a gallon.
Can I pay at the pump?
Yes, or come inside.

phrases.en: Do you have a car wash here?
Can I check the oil?
Where is the air pump?
Do you sell snacks inside?
Can I use the restroom?

dialogue.en: Do you have a car wash here?
Yes, the tunnel is around the back.
Great. Can I check the oil?
I can check it while you fill up.
Thanks. Where is the air pump?
Next to the vac, on the far side.
Okay. Do you sell snacks inside?
Yes, and coffee.
Good. Can I use the restroom?
The key is at the register.

phrases.en: The pump keeps shutting off. Is there a problem with the nozzle?
phrases.zh: 油枪一直跳。喷嘴有问题吗？

phrases.en: I paid at the pump, but it says 'see cashier.' Can you check?
phrases.zh: 我在泵上付了，但显示“请找收银员”。能查一下吗？

phrases.en: Do you have diesel? My rental is a diesel car.
phrases.zh: 有柴油吗？我的租车是柴油车。

phrases.en: Can I get a receipt with the pump number?
phrases.zh: 能给我带泵号的收据吗？

phrases.en: Is the air pump free, or does it take coins?

dialogue.en: The pump keeps shutting off. Is there a problem with the nozzle?
dialogue.zh: 油枪一直跳。喷嘴有问题吗？

dialogue.en: Try pulling it out a little. The sensor is sensitive.
dialogue.zh: 往外拔一点。感应器很灵敏。

dialogue.en: That worked. I paid at the pump, but it says 'see cashier.' Can you check?
dialogue.zh: 好了。我在泵上付了，但显示“请找收银员”。能查一下吗？

dialogue.en: The payment didn't go through. You can pay here.
dialogue.zh: 付款没成功。可以在这里付。

dialogue.en: Okay. Do you have diesel? My rental is a diesel car.
dialogue.zh: 好。有柴油吗？我的租车是柴油车。

dialogue.en: Diesel is pump 7, on the other side.
dialogue.zh: 柴油在 7 号泵，另一边。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Can I get a receipt with the pump number?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。能给我带泵号的收据吗？

dialogue.en: It prints automatically.
Good. Is the air pump free, or does it take coins?
dialogue.zh: 好。打气泵免费还是投币？

dialogue.en: It takes quarters.

phrases.en: Where can I park?
How much per hour?
Do I need a ticket?
Can I use a credit card?

dialogue.en: Excuse me, where can I park?
The garage is on your right.
How much per hour?
Four dollars an hour.
Do I need a ticket?
Yes, take one at the gate.

phrases.en: Is there a daily maximum?
Can I pay at the machine instead of the exit?
phrases.zh: 能在机器上付而不是出口付吗？

phrases.en: What happens if I lose my ticket?
Is there EV charging?
Can I park overnight?

dialogue.en: Is there a daily maximum?
Twenty-four dollars for the day.
Good. Can I pay at the machine instead of the exit?
dialogue.zh: 好。能在机器上付而不是出口付吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, the machines are by the elevator.
What happens if I lose my ticket?
You'll pay the daily maximum.
Okay. Is there EV charging?
Level 2, near the stairs.
Great. Can I park overnight?
Yes, but check the signs for street cleaning.

phrases.zh: 计时器显示超时，但我在 App 上付了。能查一下吗？

phrases.en: I got a ticket even though the sign said two-hour parking. Can I contest it?
phrases.zh: 标志写两小时停车，但我被开罚单。能申诉吗？

phrases.en: The garage is full. Is there overflow parking nearby?
phrases.zh: 停车场满了。附近有备用停车场吗？

phrases.en: Can I add time to the meter remotely?
My car was towed. Where do I pick it up?

dialogue.en: The meter says expired, but I paid through the app. Can you check?
dialogue.zh: 计时器显示超时，但我在 App 上付了。能查一下吗？

dialogue.en: Show me the confirmation and I'll note it.
dialogue.zh: 给我看确认单，我记一下。

dialogue.en: Here it is. I got a ticket even though the sign said two-hour parking. Can I contest it?
dialogue.zh: 在这里。标志写两小时停车，但我被开罚单。能申诉吗？

dialogue.en: You can contest it online with photos.
dialogue.zh: 可以在网上带照片申诉。

dialogue.en: Thanks. The garage is full. Is there overflow parking nearby?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。停车场满了。附近有备用停车场吗？

dialogue.en: The lot on 9th Street has space.
dialogue.zh: 第九街的停车场有空位。

dialogue.en: Good. Can I add time to the meter remotely?
Only through the app, not the meter.
dialogue.zh: 只能通过 App，不能直接加计时器。

dialogue.en: Okay. My car was towed. Where do I pick it up?
dialogue.zh: 好。我的车被拖走了。去哪里取？

dialogue.en: Call the number on the sign.

asks.en: Take a ticket at the gate.

phrases.en: How much is the toll?
Can I pay cash?
Do I need exact change?
Which lane takes cards?

dialogue.en: How much is the toll?
Two dollars.
Can I pay cash?
Yes, but exact change is faster.
Okay. Which lane takes cards?
The lane on the far right.

phrases.en: I don't have cash. Can I pay by card?
Do I need a transponder for the express lane?
phrases.zh: 走快速车道需要感应器吗？

phrases.en: Can I get a receipt for the toll?
Is the toll included in my rental agreement?
phrases.zh: 过路费含在租车合同里吗？

phrases.en: What happens if I miss the toll?

dialogue.en: I don't have cash. Can I pay by card?
Yes, use the reader.
Thanks. Do I need a transponder for the express lane?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。走快速车道需要感应器吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, or you'll get a bill in the mail.
dialogue.zh: 需要，否则会寄账单给你。

dialogue.en: Okay. Can I get a receipt for the toll?
I'll print one.
Good. Is the toll included in my rental agreement?
dialogue.zh: 好。过路费含在租车合同里吗？

dialogue.en: Usually not.
I see. What happens if I miss the toll?
dialogue.zh: 明白。如果我错过收费站怎么办？

dialogue.en: The rental company charges it later.

phrases.en: I was charged an admin fee on top of the toll. Can you explain it?
phrases.zh: 过路费之外还被收了管理费。能解释吗？

phrases.en: The express lane charged me twice. Can you check the plate?
phrases.zh: 快速车道扣了两次。能查一下车牌吗？

phrases.en: I have a rental car. Will the toll go to the rental company?
phrases.zh: 我开的是租车。过路费会记到租车公司吗？

phrases.en: Is there a cheaper route without tolls?
phrases.zh: 有不收费的更便宜路线吗？

phrases.en: The gate didn't open after I paid. Can you raise it?
phrases.zh: 我付了但栏杆没开。能抬杆吗？

dialogue.en: I was charged an admin fee on top of the toll. Can you explain it?
dialogue.zh: 过路费之外还被收了管理费。能解释吗？

dialogue.en: The rental company adds a daily admin fee for tolls.
dialogue.zh: 租车公司会按天收过路管理费。

dialogue.en: I see. The express lane charged me twice. Can you check the plate?
dialogue.zh: 明白。快速车道扣了两次。能查一下车牌吗？

dialogue.en: I'll look up the transactions.
Thank you. I have a rental car. Will the toll go to the rental company?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我开的是租车。过路费会记到租车公司吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, they'll bill your card later.
Okay. Is there a cheaper route without tolls?
dialogue.zh: 好。有不收费的更便宜路线吗？

dialogue.en: Route 9 is slower but free.
Thanks. The gate didn't open after I paid. Can you raise it?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我付了但栏杆没开。能抬杆吗？

dialogue.en: I'll open it now.

dialogue.en: Here is my license. This is a rental car.
dialogue.zh: 这是我的驾照。这是租的车。

I didn't see the sign. I'm sorry.

dialogue.en: Do you know why I pulled you over?
dialogue.zh: 你知道我为什么拦你吗？

dialogue.en: I'm sorry, officer. I didn't realize the speed limit changed.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，警官。我不知道限速变了。

dialogue.en: The limit dropped to 25 back there.
The rental papers are in the glove box.
Please hand them to me.
Here they are. Is this a warning or a ticket?
dialogue.zh: 在这里。这是警告还是罚单？

dialogue.en: It's a warning this time.
Thank you. How do I pay the ticket if I get one?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。如果被开罚单怎么付？

dialogue.en: The instructions are on the back.
Got it. Can I take a photo of the citation?

phrases.en: I have a Chinese driver's license and an international permit. Is that enough?
phrases.zh: 我有中国驾照和国际驾照。够吗？

phrases.en: I don't consent to a search of the vehicle. Am I required to?
phrases.zh: 我不同意搜查车辆。我必须同意吗？

phrases.en: I'm not sure I understood the stop sign. Could you explain the law?
phrases.zh: 我不太明白停车标志的规则。能解释一下吗？

phrases.en: The rental company needs a copy of the report for insurance.
phrases.zh: 租车公司需要报告副本用于保险。

phrases.en: Can I pay the fine online, or do I have to appear in court?
phrases.zh: 能在网上交罚款，还是必须出庭？

dialogue.en: License and rental agreement, please.
dialogue.zh: 请出示驾照和租车合同。

dialogue.en: I have a Chinese driver's license and an international permit. Is that enough?
dialogue.zh: 我有中国驾照和国际驾照。够吗？

dialogue.en: That's fine for a rental.
Thank you. I don't consent to a search of the vehicle. Am I required to?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我不同意搜查车辆。我必须同意吗？

dialogue.en: No, but I can ask you to step out.
dialogue.zh: 不必，但我可以请你下车。

dialogue.en: Understood. I'm not sure I understood the stop sign. Could you explain the law?
dialogue.zh: 明白。我不太明白停车标志的规则。能解释一下吗？

dialogue.en: You must come to a complete stop before the line.
dialogue.zh: 必须在停止线前完全停住。

dialogue.en: I see. The rental company needs a copy of the report for insurance.
dialogue.zh: 明白。租车公司需要报告副本用于保险。

dialogue.en: Thank you. Can I pay the fine online, or do I have to appear in court?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。能在网上交罚款，还是必须出庭？

dialogue.en: The citation explains both options, and I'll give you the case number.
dialogue.zh: 罚单上写明了两种方式，我也会给你案件号。
